## Introduction {#sec-prc-1}

[**Goals of this section**]{#sec-prc-1-goals}

The primary goal of this section is to lay a foundation for understanding statistical tests and confidence intervals that are useful for making decisions about processes and comparisons among processes. The materials covered are:

- [Scope](#sec-prc-11)
- [Assumptions](#sec-prc-12)
- [Introduction to hypothesis testing](#sec-prc-13)
- [Introduction to confidence intervals](#sec-prc-14)
- [Relationship between hypothesis testing and confidence intervals](#sec-prc-15)
- [Outlier detection](#sec-prc-16)
- [Detection of sequential trends in data or processes](#sec-prc-17)

[**Hypothesis testing and confidence intervals**]{#sec-prc-1-hypothesis-testing}

This chapter explores the types of comparisons which can be made from data and explains hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and the interpretation of each.
